mechanical.learns: Study mechanical systems, design and manufacturing, with specialization options.
mechanical.role_connection: Supports component design, prototyping and equipment work.
mechanical.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.

instrument.name: SAIT — Instrumentation Engineering Technology
instrument.learns: Work with measurement devices, calibration and automated process controls.
instrument.role_connection: Supports process testing, troubleshooting and control systems.
instrument.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.

electrical.name: SAIT — Electrical Engineering Technology
electrical.learns: Study circuits, electrical power and controls with practical laboratory work.
electrical.role_connection: Supports electrical testing and technical systems work.
electrical.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.

software.name: SAIT — Software Development
software.learns: Learn to design, test and build software across front-end and back-end systems.
software.role_connection: A foundation for junior development or testing; senior roles require further experience.
software.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.

geomatics.name: SAIT — Geomatics Engineering Technology
geomatics.learns: Learn surveying, GIS, positioning and remote sensing.
geomatics.role_connection: Supports spatial measurement and mapping data work.
geomatics.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.

ame.name: SAIT — Aircraft Maintenance Engineers Technology
ame.learns: Study aircraft systems, inspections and maintenance at the Art Smith Aero Centre.
ame.role_connection: A training route toward aircraft maintenance work.
ame.entry: A diploma is not an AME licence. Transport Canada also requires qualifying experience, demonstrated skills and examinations; see the licensing source.

avionics.name: SAIT — Avionics Technology
avionics.learns: Study aircraft electrical, electronic, communication and navigation systems.
avionics.entry: Training supports a route toward AME E licensing; graduation alone does not confer that licence. Check Transport Canada’s requirements.

machinist.name: SAIT — Machinist
machinist.learns: Learn precision measurement, machine tools, drawings and machining.
machinist.role_connection: A paid-work-and-classroom route toward making precision parts.
machinist.entry: Requires apprenticeship registration and workplace training as well as classroom instruction; admission to a course alone is not journeyperson certification.

millwright.name: SAIT — Industrial Mechanic (Millwright)
millwright.learns: Learn to install, maintain and repair industrial machinery.
millwright.role_connection: Supports equipment assembly, alignment and maintenance.
millwright.entry: Requires apprenticeship registration and workplace training. This is distinct from an engineering degree.

welder.name: SAIT — Welder
welder.learns: Learn joining processes, drawings and inspection of welded work.
welder.entry: Requires apprenticeship registration and workplace training. Check the current provincial and provider requirements.

chemical.name: University of Calgary — Chemical Engineering
chemical.learns: Study how to transform raw materials and design production processes.
chemical.role_connection: Supports process design and scale-up; experience and professional requirements remain separate.
chemical.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.

biochem.name: University of Calgary — Biochemistry
biochem.learns: Study the chemistry of living organisms and changes within cells.
biochem.role_connection: A scientific foundation for biological research; independent research positions may need further study.
biochem.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.

geology.name: University of Calgary — Geology

geology.role_connection: Supports interpreting rocks and geological evidence.
geology.entry: Check the provider’s current prerequisites and intake availability. This is a related learning route, not a hiring promise or an employer requirement.
